description: This source file defines attributes used for redacting property values within Orleans options classes. It includes the 'RedactAttribute' for general redaction and 'RedactConnectionStringAttribute' for redacting connection strings, providing mechanisms to prevent certain properties from being exposed in logs or outputs.

classes.name: RedactAttribute
classes.description: Attribute applied to properties to prevent their values from being formatted or displayed, signaling they should be redacted.

classes.name: RedactConnectionStringAttribute
classes.description: Specialized attribute extending RedactAttribute to handle redaction of connection string properties, using a utility method to mask sensitive information.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Returns a placeholder 'REDACTED' string, or, in the case of RedactConnectionStringAttribute, a masked connection string.
